features: Elegant AMOLED Display for Women - Fire-Boltt Glitz features a 1.19 inch AMOLED display with 390×390 resolution, delivering sharp visuals, rich colours and a premium viewing experience designed for women.

Always On Display with 1000 Nits Brightness - Enjoy clear visibility even under bright sunlight with 1000 nits peak brightness and Always On Display, making this women smartwatch perfect for indoor and outdoor use.
Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch - Make and receive calls directly from your wrist using Bluetooth calling with an in-built microphone and speaker, offering hands-free convenience throughout the day.
Smooth Rotating Crown Navigation - The rotating crown ensures effortless scrolling and precise control, adding a premium feel and easy navigation to this Fire-Boltt women smartwatch.
Smart Notifications & Voice Assistant - Stay updated with call alerts, WhatsApp, SMS and app notifications and use the voice assistant for quick tasks, reminders and commands on the go.
100+ Sports Modes & Activity Tracking - Track workouts with 100+ sports modes, step tracking and daily activity monitoring, making Glitz a perfect fitness smartwatch for women.
IP68 Water Resistant Design - Built with IP68 water resistance, the smartwatch is protected from sweat, splashes and dust, suitable for workouts and everyday wear.
Multiple Watch Faces for Every Style - Choose from multiple watch faces to match your outfit, mood or occasion, turning Fire-Boltt Glitz into a stylish fashion smartwatch.
Premium Strap Collection Included - Comes with three interchangeable strap styles – Silk Mesh, Heritage Steel Link and Active Silicone, designed for office, casual and active lifestyles.
Designed for Style, Comfort & Performance - Fire-Boltt Glitz blends modern technology with elegant design, making it an ideal ladies smartwatch for daily use, fitness, work and special occasions.
